notes.title: Patch Notes (January 25th)
notes.content:
We have fixed and implemented the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added boss teams for selection in Free Battle and Online Battle.
[*] Fixed a bug in Online Battle where a different character gets chosen despite the selection in rare cases.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Added boss teams for selection in Free Battle and Online Battle.

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug in Online Battle where a different character gets chosen despite the selection in rare cases.
